title: Event ingestion response
description: Body of POST /v1/events. A replay is not an error: it returns 202 with status 'duplicate' and changes no state.

status.description: 'accepted' for a first delivery, 'duplicate' for a replay of an event_id already stored for this tenant.

received_at.description: Server clock at ingestion. Analytics ordering uses this, not the client's occurred_at.
